content_parity.note: Full saved-record comparison is a separate audit; timings do not establish output equality.

measurement.primary: Successful operation compute CPU, summed over forward and reverse directions per reaction. Mapping includes final family aggregation/deduplication from the unchanged saved run.
measurement.compute_includes: Catalogue loading and decoder preparation, lazy assembly and record conversion.
measurement.compute_excludes: Result publication, external reference verification, queue wait and failed attempts.
measurement.comparison: Identical retained catalogues and event thresholds; old failures are absent from old/new successful-output pairs.
measurement.resources: Separate allocations with different memory allowances; CPU measurements are not elapsed user waiting time.
measurement.failed_measurements: Sampled process CPU and exact phase CPU overlap; do not add them together. Every total reports its measurement coverage.
measurement.missing: A missing metric or failed result is null, never a zero-duration successful result.
measurement.quantiles: Median uses the middle value or mean of two middle values; p90/p95/p99 use empirical nearest ranks.
measurement.elapsed_seconds: Per-attempt supervisor lifetime including publication, excluding time queued before dispatch; summing task lifetimes does not give campaign elapsed time.
measurement.publication: Result serialization, durable publication and associated release work; recorded separately from operation compute CPU.

latest_execution.scope: First admitted task start through last terminal attempt, including publication; excludes initial allocation wait and worker startup.

limitations: One complete execution per implementation; allocations and memory allowances differ. The comparison measures observed CPU use, not a universal per-case speed guarantee.
The 47 missing baseline directions cannot establish old/new output equality or an old successful CPU comparison. All are complete in the new run.
Full saved-record parity is a separate audit and remains pending.

notes: Allocated CPU-seconds sum only the ten completed allocation rows; no child steps, cancelled unstarted submissions, or subsequent output-audit allocations are counted.
Task total CPU includes computation and publication, but excludes coordinator, supervisor and allocation startup CPU; its fraction of allocation capacity is not whole-system utilization.
Task CPU per span second is a whole-run average, not peak parallelism.
Zero phase peaks mean no sample in that phase, not zero memory.
